intro: Utopia keeps everything you need, right where you want it. Rich Sheesham wood, spacious drawers, and classic design create a bedside table that’s as functional as it is beautiful.

features.title: Wood that’s tough and beautifully made
features.text: Invest in lasting beauty with Sheesham wood—its rich texture and timeless strength make every piece a statement in your home.

features.title: Materials that stand up to everyday life
features.text: Built to last! This material resists decay, splitting, and termites, ensuring your furniture stays beautiful and durable long-term.

features.title: Easy-access shelf for everyday items
features.text: Stay clutter-free with extra storage space that keeps your books, devices, and daily items within easy reach.

features.title: Convenient drawer for quick storage
features.text: With smooth-gliding drawers that open effortlessly, our design keeps your bedside essentials organised and within reach, making every morning and night a little easier.

features.title: Natural brown finish adds cozy vibes
features.text: Our hand-waxed wood finish celebrates every natural grain, highlighting unique patterns that bring organic aesthetic and authentic character to your home.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
